requirements: R1: Fix four confirmed audit findings by replacing hardcoded stubs with real evaluation, enforcing PR security blocks for vulnerabilities, and reverting generated TaskService modifications to an append-only override.

slices.title: Resolve four falsification audit findings
slices.jtbd: When implementing the falsification fixes for this epic, I want to remove stubs and enforce required constraints, so that falsified success reports are actually blocked.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the coverage audit file, When the audit test runs, Then it verifies real specification gaps are produced rather than a hardcoded empty list.
Given a PR containing security vulnerabilities, When code review simulation runs, Then it explicitly blocks the PR in the test.
Given the TaskService implementation, When modifications are needed, Then tests verify they are implemented via append-only overriding components and generated files are left untouched.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce falsified success reports from >0% to 0%

requirements: R1: Fix the systemic synchronization failure between internal 'done' statuses and GitHub PR 'closed without merge' states.

slices.title: Fix GitHub PR and internal task status sync
slices.jtbd: When implementing the status synchronization for this epic, I want to correctly map closed PRs to internal states, so that tasks are not falsely marked as done.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a GitHub PR that is closed without a merge, When the system processes the state in tests, Then the internal task status correctly reflects the closed state instead of marking it done.
Given the explicit WARN logs for internal mismatch, When the synchronization test checks the system, Then these WARN logs are confirmed eliminated.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce false 'done' statuses for unmerged PRs from >0 to 0
